instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a natural, documentary feel captures a full-length, eye-level shot of friends walking along a dirt path in a lush green forest park during the daytime. On the far left, the young woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R1) walks forward smiling, carrying a rolled-up purple blanket under her left arm. Next to her, a bystander young man in a red-and-white striped t-shirt walks along. To his right, the young woman with a white patterned headband (R2) walks forward smiling with a black camera around her neck. On the far right, the bearded man in a black t-shirt and blue jeans (R4) walks with a blue cap worn backward, smiling as he looks down. The group moves forward together under bright, diffused daylight filtering through the trees, creating soft shadows and a warm, natural color palette.
